input.description: ACT-2. The JSON Schema of this Action's input, and the whole of what a caller sends. A console renders a form from it without having been told anything else about the Worker.

result.description: ACT-3. The JSON Schema of what a performance answers, absent where it answers nothing. ACT-10 draws `200` and `204` at exactly this.

completesWithinCall.description: ACT-4. Declared rather than discovered, because a caller decides whether it can wait before it sends. ACT-11: one that does not answers `202` with no body.

idempotency.description: ACT-12, ENDP-15. Absent where the Action takes no key.

readAddress.description: ACT-15. Where a GET answers a document this Action would accept. Required of `configure` and optional for every other Action — which is a condition on the KEY an entry is held under, and so a rule rather than a shape.
readAddress.title: Address

title: Action declaration
description: ACT-2. One Action, held under its name in the `actions` entry. The name is the Worker's own: NAME-7 does not reach it, because it is resolved inside the Descriptor that declared it. `configure` is the one name ACT-13 reserves.
